scope_controls.prohibited_material_note: No original or revised manuscript, Response to Reviewers, revision-evidence bundle, patch/apply report, author adjudication, Phase 2A/2B artifact, or prior Round-1/Round-2 re-review artifact or audit was inspected.
scope_controls.write_scope: Only this audit artifact was created; the precommitment and all other inputs were left unchanged.

audit_standard.criterion_inheritance: Each Phase-1 row may only operationalize the inherited Round-1 criterion in the order: roadmap verification_criteria; strict per-item decision-letter Acceptance criteria when present; driving finding; frozen Round-1 reviewer card and target. It may not extend that yardstick.
audit_standard.must_fix_shape: FULLY_ADDRESSED, PARTIALLY_ADDRESSED, and MADE_WORSE must each be concrete and collectively preserve every material conjunct of the inherited criterion.
audit_standard.should_fix_shape: The row commits only a concrete FULLY_ADDRESSED pattern; PARTIALLY_ADDRESSED and MADE_WORSE remain the protocol-level derived rules.
audit_standard.expected_change_surface: A navigation hypothesis derived only from Round-1 proposed targets; it is neither a satisfaction requirement nor evidence that a revision occurred there.
audit_standard.revision_blindness: No revision content, author persuasion, patch/apply information, verdict, or inference about what changed may enter Phase 1.
audit_standard.routing: Normalize the verbatim reviewer string; route to the first non-DA scoring label, otherwise EIC. DA is never a verification persona.

binding_and_coverage_checks.binding_note: The editorial synthesis has no strict Required Item Details / R<n> / single-line Acceptance criteria blocks, so omitting letter_text and letter_item_ref is faithful. Summary tables were not promoted into a new criterion layer.

item_results.rationale: The FULL pattern preserves all four inherited conjuncts: named closest comparators, shared producer-checker features, P33-specific owner semantics, and bounded originality language. PARTIAL explicitly enumerates each missing conjunct, while MADE_WORSE is limited to regression in comparator specificity or the originality-support boundary. It adds no venue-fit or novelty-proof test.

The operationalization retains every per-artifact retrieval field and the inherited explicit-unavailability alternative. PARTIAL covers any missing field or unsupported retrievability implication; MADE_WORSE covers lost or conflicting identifiers, weakened availability disclosure, and strengthened unsupported retrievability.

The FULL pattern preserves the two named correction records, independent resolvability, base-plus-correction use binding, claim-boundary preservation, and the separately authorized bibliography mutation. The authorization condition is inherited verbatim rather than newly introduced. The surface lists only the two proposed manuscript blocks and does not pretend they authorize references.bib.

The FULL pattern exactly preserves the two-part criterion: a field-facing methods account without role-by-role narration, and provenance separation for any retained phase history. No new structural or venue requirement is added.

FULL retains the frozen independently authored fixtures and oracle provenance, the complete trust-graph actor set, classification of every shared dependency, producer-code exclusion from predicate kernels, and all three component provenance hashes. PARTIAL explicitly treats any missing component, actor, or classification as residual. MADE_WORSE stays tied to deterioration of the independence/trust evidence or newly shared producer decision logic.

FULL and PARTIAL preserve all seven schema-contract elements: canonical bytes, closed enums, proof-type registry, state transitions, digest domain, validator predicates, and valid/invalid fixture bytes. MADE_WORSE concretely distinguishes erosion of deterministic serialization, bounded values, transition/predicate rules, digest scope, or fixture coverage.

The operationalization applies the complete seven-part producer contract to each surface-specific producer. PARTIAL names both producer coverage and every possible missing component. MADE_WORSE is confined to loss of executable/exhaustive bounds, exact cutoff or termination, coverage/unresolved accounting, or independent population-bound replay.

FULL preserves every row-level field and the exact 20-source/48-use reconciliation. PARTIAL treats either a missing field or unreconciled aggregate as incomplete. MADE_WORSE remains limited to degraded retrieval, screening, passage/hypothesis traceability, unavailable-total honesty, or count consistency.

The FULL pattern retains presentation, generator data, specialization, cutoff-predicate inputs, canonical digest, and the producer contract's binding to those exact values. It adds no demand for execution or a census result.

The FULL pattern retains cardinality, deduplication, canonical member order, inverse self-link behavior, deterministic owner-ID derivation, and the no-double-counting consequence. No unrelated schema property is introduced.

The FULL pattern preserves the non-scientific valid and invalid BP/CP cases and, for each, the private payload, semantic mapping, adapter predicate, validator transition, fail-closed result, and prohibition on presenting the fixture as a census outcome.

The FULL pattern preserves exact schema-and-registry digest equality as the default and retains the independent migration version, digest, and complete transformed-output revalidation requirements. It neither broadens compatibility policy nor adds an implementation result.

FULL preserves the universal assumption-labeling rule, the exact separately authorized source/proof exception, architecture-only use, and the prohibition on arithmetic or Route conclusions. PARTIAL and MADE_WORSE preserve the same boundaries. The DA source label is correctly retained while routing defaults to EIC because DA cannot serve as verifier.

closure_basis: All 13 rows are semantically faithful to their inherited Round-1 criteria, introduce no new acceptance standard, use concrete and criterion-complete operationalizations appropriate to their obligation class, keep expected surfaces as Round-1-derived navigation hypotheses, disclose no revision content, and route to the correct frozen-card seat. The audit is therefore closed PASS.
